svg.title: U-Mamba2 architecture (ToothFairy3 Task 1)
svg.desc: A U-shaped network drawn as 3D blocks. A 1-channel CBCT patch of 160 by 288 by 288 voxels goes through a stem convolution and seven encoder stages of residual blocks with 32, 64, 128, 256, 320, 320 and 320 channels. Stages 2 to 6 halve every side with a stride-2 residual block, down to 5 by 9 by 9; stage 7 keeps that size. At the bottleneck a Mamba2 layer processes the 5 by 9 by 9 grid as 405 tokens. The decoder has six stages: each upsamples with a transposed convolution, concatenates the matching encoder features and applies one 3 by 3 by 3 convolution. A final 1 by 1 by 1 convolution gives 47 class scores per voxel.
svg.text: 5 × 9 × 9 · flatten to 405 tokens → LayerNorm → Mamba2 → reshape
numbers above the blocks = channels · sizes on the green arrows = feature-map size in voxels
residual blocks (×n), each two 3×3×3 convs + shortcut
residual block with stride 2: halves each side
transposed conv, stride 2: doubles each side
Mamba2 layer over the whole bottleneck
same block with stride 1: size kept
